item.title: Public hearing held on proposed 30-bed hospital in Columbus County

item.title: Wilmington Officers trade badges for Santa hats at annual Santa Cop event
item.description: NEW HANOVER COUNTY (WWAY) — The Wilmington Police Department retired their badges for Santa hats Friday for their annual Santa Cop event. For more than 30 years, the Wilmington Police Department has hosted its Santa Cop event, providing Christmas joy to the children and families that need a little extra help this year. item.description: NEW HANOVER COUNTY (WWAY) — The Cape Crooners pass hall to hall around Trinity Grove nursing home to spread a little bit of Christmas cheer to the resident seniors.
